spans.s: दग्ध a. (f. ग्धा) 1. Burnt, consumed by fire; 2. tortured, pained, consumed by grief; 3. tasteless, insipid; 4. inauspicious; 5. a term of abuse usually prefixed to the word it vilifies, को देहीति वदेत्स्वदग्धजठरस्यार्थे मनस्वी जनः Bhartr.iii.8.
